cases.description: General advice about day trading options vs shares — pure commentary

input.rawHtml:
I personally dont think you need to DT options anyways. I find shares a lot easier to manage especially with DT margin. You dont pay unless you hold overnight so theres no issue with BP on the larger positions. Also it's a lot faster to execute a trade and to get in/out with shares. Today I was futzing around with options on UBER after my entry was confirmed and probably lost about 0.20 of profit before giving up and just taking a shares entry.  
@JBS: I hit my targets with 1 share, and I sized up in November. had a learning curve in November, learnings to day trade options and navigating the choppy markets, but things are turning around in december... View
input.author: Isidore

cases.notes: Educational commentary about shares vs options trading. Mentions UBER incidentally in a past-tense anecdote, not as a signal.
